Avril Haines, the former Director of National Intelligence who ordered me and
thousands of other intelligence officials to [overlook concerns about war
crimes](https://www.wsj.com/politics/national-security/u-s-and-israels-

intelligence to the Israeli military, has had the grace to largely avoid the
public eye since leaving office, which is what you or I might do if we [felt
responsible](https://www.politico.com/news/magazine/2024/10/29/avril-haines-

Not so for the small inner circle of Biden advisers who gave Haines _her_
orders. The men behind Joe Biden's genocidal "bear hug" policy of
unconditional US support for the Israeli government are now popping up
everywhere from Stephen Colbert to the op-ed pages of the _New York Times_ to
[their own podcasts](https://podcasts.voxmedia.com/show/the-long-game),
presenting themselves as responsible experts critiquing Trump's chaotic
foreign policy. The Biden guys, far from seeking anonymity or amnesty, expect
to be rewarded for their performance in Gaza with continued influence in the
Democratic Party and powerful roles in the next administration. That's why,
even knee-deep in multiple Trump crises, we can't afford to ignore the
